in_sanskrit.name: Vakeel
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Learned, Scholar, Lawyer
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vakeel एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Someone who is well-versed in a subject or law. A lawyer, a sage, a scholar, or someone who has acquired knowledge through study and practice.

in_hindi.name: वाकिल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who serves words or documents in a court of law. The term is of Persian origin and was adopted in India due to the historical influence of Persian culture on Indian legal traditions.

in_tamil.name: Vakeel
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Learned, Scholar, Lawyer
in_tamil.long_meaning: Vakeel ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Someone who is well-versed in a subject or law. A lawyer, a sage, a scholar, or someone who has acquired knowledge through study and practice.
